title: AlphaAgentEvo: Evolution-Oriented Alpha Mining via Self-Evolving Agentic Reinforcement Learning
central_strategy: Train a multi-turn Qwen3 policy with agentic reinforcement learning to make up to four factor-generation/evaluation tool calls, optimize a five-component hierarchical reward over quality, diversity, novelty, validity, and tool efficiency, retain the best alpha offspring, and form a cross-sectional top-10-percent portfolio rebalanced every five trading days.

required_but_missing: The listed supplementary ZIP containing the promised dataset and training/evaluation source; current immutable access is 404 and API access is 403.
AlphaEvo500/Alpha158 inputs, HS300/CSI500 point-in-time market data, exact splits, evaluator, parser, and backtest server.
Paper prompts, Qwen3 checkpoints, multi-turn trajectories, native tool calls, reward components, offspring factors, signs, and selected alpha pool.
Training environment, complete Verl/GRPO configuration, seeds, repeated runs, baselines, validation/test outputs, and result arrays.
Portfolio weighting, costs/slippage, holdings, returns, figure arrays, and result generator.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_paper_specification_is_not_a_signal: The paper describes the agent/tool/reward architecture and portfolio shell but prints no final alpha formula, factor pool, checkpoint action, or formation-date score.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_third_party_candidates_are_excluded: Neither candidate is attributable to a paper author. One is a mismatched 0.6B step-50 checkpoint; the other uses Vietnam data, a different reward and split, exceeds the tool-call cap, stops at step 90, and omits the parser/backtest backend.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_local_proxy_is_excluded: The local monthly evolved-seed proxy is a favorable motif translation with no AlphaAgentEvo policy, reward, tool, factor, or result lineage.
monthly_jkp_assessment.why_jkp_cannot_fill_the_gap: JKP can evaluate a disclosed alpha but cannot infer the missing learned agent policy or its offspring formulas. Choosing a generic evolved factor would manufacture the strategy output.
monthly_jkp_assessment.reward_ambiguity: The printed tool-cost term can be zero or negative while serving as a denominator, with no floor or sign rule; third-party floors are adaptations rather than recovered paper semantics.

closure_rule: Do not promote unaffiliated checkpoints, partial third-party training, the local motif proxy, or a newly generated JKP factor to AlphaAgentEvo. Reopen if the official supplement or attributable factor/checkpoint/action lineage becomes accessible.
